ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a table titled “Virtual water content of some agricultural products in Israel in 1999,” with the unit m³/kg. The table lists the virtual water content of products such as barley, wheat, bananas, citrus, carrots, vegetables, dairy cattle, beef cattle, poultry, and laying hens, with obvious differences in values; among them, carrots, vegetables, etc. are relatively low, while livestock products such as dairy cattle, beef cattle, and laying hens generally consume more water. Then reason: Virtual water indicates the amount of water needed to produce goods. Northwest China is arid and short of water, so agricultural development should as far as possible choose directions with low water consumption per unit output and high water-use efficiency, reducing pressure on water resources. Therefore, high-efficiency water-saving agriculture should be developed.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：表格列出不同农产品的虚拟水含量，且不同产品差异很大，畜牧类普遍高于多数蔬菜、作物。再读题干：西北地区为干旱地区，问题限定“从虚拟水角度”问应发展什么农业。把虚拟水高低与干旱区水资源短缺相连接，得出应发展单位产出耗水少、用水效率高的农业，即高效节水农业。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一张“以色列1999年部分农产品的虚拟水含量”表，单位为m³/kg。表内列出大麦、小麦、香蕉、柑橘、胡萝卜、蔬菜、奶牛、肉牛、家禽、蛋鸡等产品的虚拟水含量，数值差异明显；其中胡萝卜、蔬菜等较低，而奶牛、肉牛、蛋鸡等畜牧类产品总体耗水较高。再推理：虚拟水表示生产商品所需水量。我国西北地区干旱缺水，因此农业发展应尽量选择单位产出耗水少、用水效率高的方向，减少水资源压力。所以应发展高效节水农业。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Directly uses the numeric contrasts in the table to infer the principle of minimizing water embodied in local agricultural production.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the table title as virtual water content of agricultural products and note the listed water-use values: crops/vegetables such as胡萝卜0.064、蔬菜0.069、香蕉0.252 m³/kg are far lower than livestock-related products such as奶牛177.8、蛋鸡31.09、肉牛15.5 m³/kg.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the definition in the question that virtual water is the water needed to produce goods and services, and use the target phrase asking what agriculture Northwest arid China should develop.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Virtual water means water consumed to produce goods; in an arid region, agriculture should reduce water input per unit output and avoid high virtual-water production, so the appropriate development direction is efficient water-saving agriculture.
